title: Akatonbo
attribution: "Red Dragonfly": music by Kōsaku Yamada (died 1965), set in 1927 to a poem by Rofū Miki (died 1964) written in 1921. Public domain: published before 1931 (United States) and all authors died before 1972 (Canada). Melody and all four verses from the score and numbered notation in Yamada's own songbook (National Diet Library digital collection).
